import socket

sock_path = "/tmp/arc-pa-389bk25k/daemon.sock"

def daemon_request(protocol_request):
    """Send a request via the daemon protocol and return response"""
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.connect(sock_path)
    # Send protocol request bytes
    to_send = bytearray(str(protocol_request, 'utf-8').encode('utf-8'))
    sock.sendall(bytes([
        *to_send,
        0x00,  # null byte
    ]))
    sock.settimeout(2)
    response = sock.recv(65536)
    sock.close()
    return response.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
